notes:
APIOps introduction. Technical continuation is illustrative; no client implementation or measured improvement is claimed.

Recommended AI working pattern derived from the scaffold AGENTS.md and method guidance. The new-api-guide skill prefers the shared method engine and station readiness criteria. Canvas JSON authoring and export skills support reviewable decisions. The presence of a starter OpenAPI file does not establish design readiness. This is guidance for AI-assisted work, not a claim that the initializer automates implementation.
